overview: A tech-and-markets-heavy day: SpaceX posts Q3 2026 results on Oct 20, Tesla is pushing shareholder votes ahead of its Dec 3 meeting, and Coinbase now lets AI agents trade index and crypto perps. Agent products dominated the feed, including Wabi 2.0's group-chat agent and Musk's heavy promotion of Grok Bot. Political posts, much of the Ackman and horowitz_b feeds, were skipped.

top_items.title: elonmusk - SpaceX will post Q3 2026 financial and operational results on Oct 20, with a live audio-only webcast at 3:30
elonmusk - Tesla's annual meeting is set for Dec 3, and the company is asking shareholders to vote 'FOR' all three proposals
brian_armstrong - Coinbase for Agents now lets AI agents trade perps on S&P-style, top-100 tech and top-10 AI indices, plus 20+ tokens
elonmusk - Musk says he will give one of his SpaceX shares to every kid in America next year, calling it 'the first of many'
tobi - Shopify's CEO says Wabi 2.0, a shared AI agent that a family or friend group uses in one thread, is 'extremely well crafted'
tobi - Lütke shares Anthropic's research on employment at Anthropic, alongside the same visualization built from inside Shopify
burrytracker - Shares a Reuters-attributed warning that the $1.7T US auto loan market is headed for a crash, with 1 in 5 Americans behind on a loan
elonmusk - Musk pushes Grok Bot hard as an agent with its own computer, email and voice that can even make purchases with your card
